lineage.strategy: Add independent current execution/cash-use evidence instead of repeating existing Scout lineage.

observations.fact: Reported management guidance raised 2026 operating cash use to $120-$150 million from $80-$100 million and PP&E purchases to $400-$500 million from $350-$450 million, tied to accelerated procurement, construction and grid work for project schedules.
The report states Oklo ended the quarter with just over $3 billion in cash and marketable securities and that Aurora INL site mobilization was underway with reactor-area excavation near completion.

risks.risk: Accelerated spending increases execution exposure before Aurora INL generates operating output; schedule protection does not itself prove commissioning success or future economics.

unknowns.unknown: Final project cost, commissioning timing variance and unit economics remain unresolved by this source.

recommendation: Use as source-addressed capital-intensity and execution evidence; Alpha should corroborate numeric guidance against issuer filing before canonical numeric use.
